item.title: ConformTXT 0.6.18
item.description: - Tables copied from TextEdit, Pages or Notes keep their lines. - The clipboard comes back exactly as you copied it, and ConformTXT's temporary version never syncs to your other devices. - A slow web app can no longer get the paste twice, and a paste that was called off can't fire late. - Big copies from Excel or Word start faster, and a copied picture with no words is pasted straight away. - Dvorak and other keyboard layouts: ⌘V is the key that types V.
